contexts.text: The tithes, or tenths = remains. AC 680:end.
Hence the tithing number was holy.
Ten is therefore predicated of remains. Illustrated. AC 575:end. AC 755:2. AC 1963. AC 1988:2. AC 2109. AC 2636:2. AC 2959:7. AC 4670:end.
That ten, like tenths = remains. Fully illustrated. AC 2280. Explained.
The tenth month () = the truths which are of remains.
Tithes () = remains, which, being of the Lord alone, are holy.
Tenths () = remains, or states of good and truth from combats. AC 1738, Explained.
From the end of ten years () = (the Lord's) remains of good and truth.
The Angels do not know what ten is; but the moment it is mentioned by man, there comes to them the idea of remains...
Ten = remains through which is conjunction. Illustrated.
Those with whom there is a state of the affection of truth, are signified by ten (in Sodom).
Three tenths of fine flour offered with the son of an ox; only two tenths with a ram; and with a lamb, one tenth.
If ten were found there, the city should be spared = if there were still any remains, that is, anything of good and truth. AC 2284, Explained.
The good of infancy is until the tenth year.
The tenth generation = remains. Explained.
The flock which he will take tithe of () = the remains of good which he will do violence to.

Ten camels () = general scientifics. Ten = remains... which, when predicated of the Lord, are the Divine things which He acquired for Himself... and as the general scientifics were Divine, or acquired by the Lord, it is said that they were ten.
Ten of gold their weight () = full for initiation; for ten = a full state, like a hundred.
Days, at least ten () = the state for departure appearing to them full... Ten = what is full.

All Thou shalt give, tithing I will tithe it to Thee () = that the Lord made each and all things Divine by His Own power... To tithe, and tithes = the goods and truths which are stored up by the Lord in the interiors of man... and which, when predicated of the Lord, are the Divine goods and Divine truths which He acquired for Himself by His Own power.
He hath changed my wages ten ways () = ... a very great change (in them). AC 4179.
The ten virgins = all who are in the Church; both those in good and truth, and those in evil and falsity. Ten = remains, and also what is full, thus all. AC 10253:end. DSS 17:2. AE 675:6.
To tithe, in the Word, = to make remains, that is, to collect truths and goods and then store them up.
See Five. AC 5291:5.
Ten donkeys () = many things of service. Ten = much. AC 5959.

In the tenth day of this month () = the state of initiation of the interiors. The tenth day = the state of the interiors; for... ten = remains... and as these are in the interiors, and through them man is prepared and initiated to receive good and truth from the Lord, therefore by the tenth day is here signified a state of initiation of the interiors.
Ten = what is full; hence a tenth part = as much as is sufficient. AC 8540. AC 9595.
For when ten = much, a tenth part = little.
Princes of tens () = primary truths in the third place... Tens = many things, but in a less degree.
Ten = all. AC 9636.
The ten words = all truths of doctrine and goods of life. AC 10689.
Ten curtains = all truths from which.
Ten bases = supporting truths as much as sufficient for use.
Ten, here, involves the like as fifty, or five, namely, what is sufficient for use; for ten arises from five by multiplication.
The tenth of an ephah = as much as is sufficient, and as much as is sufficient for use.
The diameter of ten cubits = what is full.
Ten = much, all, and what is full. References.
They were called the ten words because ten = all. DLife 61, Illustrated. TCR 286. AE 675. AE 935:2. AE 1024:2.
Hence come tithes by which are signified something from all things.
Ye shall have affliction ten days () = that temptation will last the full time. ( = some time. AE 124.)
As ten = what is full, it also = much and many, and also everything and all. Illustrated.
Ten = much.
Ten pounds = much. AE 548:4.
A tenth part () = all there.
Ten horns () = much power. AE 716. AE 776. AE 1069.
Ten diadems () = many truths of the Word falsified. AE 777.
(Ten Spirits visit a heavenly Society.)
Ten cities = much intelligence and wisdom. AE 223:end.
Ten horns () = falsities of every kind; for ten = all.
Under Psaltery, see this reference.
Ten = many things.
Ten men () = all who are such; for ten = all people and all things. AE 433:27.
10, 100, and 1000 = much, and all.
A tenth part of the city fell = no truths of doctrine any longer. Ten = all; also many and much; and a tenth part = all and much.
That ten = all persons and all things, and also many persons and many things. Illustrated.

The ten servants = all who are in the world; in special, in the Church... The ten pounds = all the Knowledges of truth and good from the Word, with the faculty to perceive them... Those who acquire much are meant by the servant who from a pound gained ten pounds...
The ten talents = much wisdom.
Ten () is here predicated of truth, and of all of it.
Ten times = at all times, or always. Illustrated.

Hence the tenth part = everything. It is from this that tithes and tithings derived their origin; and signified that everything was holy and blessed when the tenth part... was given to the Levites: and in like manner for the Levites, when the tenth part was again tithed and given to Aaron. Illustrated.

That ten = all things, originated from Heaven itself... All the forces of life of the Grand Man cease in the two hands and feet, and these cease in the ten digits; and therefore all things of man as to power, and as to support, being finally collated into the ten digits, these = all things of man; and besides, ultimates, in the Word, also = all things.
Ten (degrees backward) () = many.
Tan horns = much power.
